test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which is the apex governing body of air sports in India?

options.text: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

solution:
The correct answer is __**Air Sports Federation of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Air Sports Federation of India (ASFI) was established to govern and promote air sports in India.
 
• ASFI works under the guidelines of the Federation Aeronautique Internationale (FAI), the world governing body for air sports.
 
• The federation aims to provide a structured framework and ensure safety standards in various air sports activities.
 
• ASFI collaborates with different stakeholders, including government agencies, to develop infrastructure and training facilities for air sports enthusiasts.
 
• The organization plays a crucial role in organizing national and international air sports events in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Federation Aeronautique Internationale (FAI)**

 
 
• FAI is the world governing body for air sports, founded in 1905.
 
• It oversees various air sports disciplines including paragliding, ballooning, and aerobatics.
 
• FAI sets international standards and regulations for air sports to ensure safety and fair competition.
 
 
 
• **Types of Air Sports**
 
 
• Air sports include activities such as paragliding, hang gliding, skydiving, and hot air ballooning.
 
• Each sport has specific training and certification requirements to ensure participant safety.
 
 
 
• **Safety in Air Sports**
 
 
• Safety is a primary concern in air sports, with strict regulations and guidelines in place.
 
• Participants are required to undergo thorough training and certification before engaging in these activities.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure for Air Sports**
 
 
• Developing infrastructure such as airfields, training centers, and equipment is crucial for the growth of air sports.
 
• Government and private sector collaboration is essential to build and maintain these facilities.
